passages.text: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John, who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ received a revelation from God.
God gave this revelation to Jesus Christ.
God wanted to show His servants what must soon happen.
God made these things known through Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ sent His angel to His servant John.
The angel delivered the message to John.
John is the servant of Jesus Christ.
John testifies to everything he saw.
John testifies to the word of God.
John testifies to the testimony of Jesus Christ.
This message is the word of God.
This message is the testimony of Jesus Christ.
passages.original: Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεός δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει καὶ ἐσήμανεν ἀποστείλας διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου αὐτοῦ τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννῃ ὃς ἐμαρτύρησεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὅσα εἶδεν

passages.text: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.
passages.sermon:
This prophecy comes from God.
This prophecy contains words that God gave to Jesus Christ.
God gave these words to show His servants what must soon happen.
God sent His angel to make these things known to John.
John is God's servant.
John testifies to everything he saw.
This prophecy is the word of God.
This prophecy is the testimony of Jesus Christ.
God blesses the person who reads aloud the words of this prophecy.
God blesses those who hear these words.
God blesses those who obey what is written in this prophecy.
The time is near.
passages.original: Μακάριος ὁ ἀναγινώσκων καὶ οἱ ἀκούοντες τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας καὶ τηροῦντες τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς ἐγγύς

passages.text: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven Spirits before His throne, and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood, who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
passages.sermon:
John writes to the seven churches in the province of Asia.
He greets them with grace and peace.
This grace and peace come from God.
God is the One who is.
God is the One who was.
God is the One who is to come.
Grace and peace also come from the seven Spirits before God's throne.
Grace and peace also come from Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ is the faithful witness.
Jesus Christ is the firstborn from the dead.
Jesus Christ is the ruler of the kings of the earth.
Jesus Christ loves us.
Jesus Christ has freed us from our sins by His blood.
Jesus Christ has made us a kingdom.
Jesus Christ has made us priests to His God and Father.
To Jesus Christ belong glory and power forever and ever.
Amen.
passages.original: Ἰωάννης Ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις ταῖς ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἑπτὰ Πνευμάτων ἃ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστός ὁ πρωτότοκος τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς Τῷ ἀγαπῶντι ἡμᾶς καὶ λύσαντι ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς βασιλείαν ἱερεῖς τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρὶ αὐτοῦ αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν

passages.text: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
passages.sermon:
Jesus will come with the clouds.
Every person will see Jesus.
The people who pierced Jesus will see Him.
All the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Jesus.
This will happen.
Amen.
passages.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν πᾶς ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ οἵτινες αὐτὸν ἐξεκέντησαν καὶ κόψονται ἐπ’ αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς ναί ἀμήν

passages.text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks.
The Lord God is the Almighty.
The Lord God is the one who is.
The Lord God is the one who was.
The Lord God is the one who is to come.
The Lord God says, “I am the Alpha and the Omega.”
passages.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεός ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ὁ Παντοκράτωρ

passages.text: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
passages.sermon:
I am John.
I am your brother.
I share with you in suffering for Jesus.
I share with you in the kingdom that is in Jesus.
I share with you in patient endurance in Jesus.
I was on the island called Patmos.
I was there because of the word of God.
I was there because of my testimony about Jesus.
passages.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ συνκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ἐν Ἰησοῦ ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet, saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
passages.sermon:
John was on the island of Patmos.
It was the Lord’s day.
I was in the Spirit.
I heard a loud voice behind me.
The voice sounded like a trumpet.
The voice spoke to me.
The voice said, “Write what you see in a book.
Send it to the seven churches.
Send it to Ephesus.
Send it to Smyrna.
Send it to Pergamum.
Send it to Thyatira.
Send it to Sardis.
Send it to Philadelphia.
Send it to Laodicea.”
passages.original: ἐγενόμην ἐν Πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἤκουσα ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος λεγούσης Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν

passages.text: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands, and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.
passages.sermon:
I am John.
I am your brother.
I share with you in suffering, in the kingdom, and in patient endurance in Jesus.
I was on the island called Patmos.
I was there because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
On the Lord’s day, I was in the Spirit.
I heard a loud voice behind me.
The voice sounded like a trumpet.
The voice spoke with me.
I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me.
When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.
Among the lampstands, I saw someone like the Son of Man.
He wore a long robe.
He had a golden sash around His chest.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα βλέπειν τὴν φωνὴν ἥτις ἐλάλει μετ’ ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐπιστρέψας εἶδον ἑπτὰ λυχνίας χρυσᾶς καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν λυχνιῶν ὅμοιον υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου ἐνδεδυμένον ποδήρη καὶ περιεζωσμένον πρὸς τοῖς μαστοῖς ζώνην χρυσᾶν

passages.text: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
passages.sermon:
I saw a man among the golden lampstands.
He looked like the Son of Man.
The hair on His head was white.
It was white like wool.
It was as white as snow.
His eyes were like a blazing fire.
passages.original: ἡ δὲ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ τρίχες λευκαὶ ὡς ἔριον λευκόν ὡς χιών καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός

passages.text: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
passages.sermon:
Jesus stood among the seven golden lampstands.
His feet looked like polished bronze.
The bronze was refined in a furnace.
His voice sounded like the roar of many waters.
passages.original: καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ ὡς ἐν καμίνῳ πεπυρωμένης καὶ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν

passages.text: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
passages.sermon:
Jesus appeared in a vision.
He held seven stars in His right hand.
A sharp, double-edged sword came from His mouth.
His face shone like the sun at its brightest.
passages.original: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀστέρας ἑπτά καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ

passages.text: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last, the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
passages.sermon:
Jesus appeared to John.
Jesus is the First and the Last.
Jesus is the Living One.
Jesus was dead.
Now Jesus is alive forever and ever.
Jesus holds the keys of Death and of Hades.
When John saw Jesus, he fell at Jesus’ feet like a dead man.
Jesus placed His right hand on John.
Jesus said, “Do not be afraid.”
passages.original: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπ’ ἐμὲ λέγων Μὴ φοβοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος καὶ ὁ Ζῶν καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου

passages.text: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
passages.sermon:
Jesus appeared to John in a vision.
Jesus spoke to John.
Jesus commanded John to write.
Jesus said, “Write what you have seen.
Write what is now.
Write what will happen after this.”
passages.original: Γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα

passages.text: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
passages.sermon:
Jesus holds seven stars in His right hand.
Jesus stands among seven golden lampstands.
The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches.
The seven lampstands are the seven churches.
passages.original: τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν
